content: Asana p'akhuri ẹkhakhaama
“Idikha ọnọng ofhu ẹbhaam, obiro ode orukhimaan, ọfhẹ-ẹ, ode bi okpẹ-ẹ okpe o, kẹ ọkhaambi otzuk abhaam azen k'ẹbhaam dani, arukhimaan anna k'orukhimaan wani.
“Idikha bọng abọk oriribha da ọm-ọvọkhi ibe k'erungi, attum-ẹ maa ope, ọnọng kw'ottum-ẹ, iponga s'ẹnọngmon kẹ kípyibh.

Yina, idikha ọfhẹ-ẹ da ewu ekk'ekhobha, aponga p'ẹnọngmon akk'ẹ ipyibha e. “Oriribha ọkhaambi orik ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ofhu, idikha ọn-ọttọhk ọkhaam, bẹ akhaambi akpẹ-ẹ atzima atzera eho ch'ọttọhk f'ofhu.
“Idikha bẹ are etzen ch'ofhu da etzim erukhi akpen ka mbọhk sẹ, ode ẹbhaam, ode ẹnyanyaang, obiro ode orukhimaan o, kẹ ọkhaambi otzuk chẹ k'igbe ifa.

“Idikha ọnọng otzim etzirakpo pyẹ bi, ọtza ọnang ọchattọhk, ettena ẹtza echi owoni, obiro ode owoni kw'ọnọng kwa grep o, kẹ ọkhaambi da otzuk ekpo py'ọnọng nwa, ttara ekpo ọkkakka py'efon k'owoni kwẹ kw'agrep.

“Idikha ọnọng okhumi owoni kwẹ, kw'ọwọhm maa ojekha k'owoni kw'oyok, ekpon ẹkwọmi ekpo py'oyok ọyaabh, obiro ode py'oyok ọkk'ọpha otzobha, ọnọng kw'okhe ekpon nda, ọkhaambi otzuk oyok ekpo pyẹ py'ẹkwọmi.
“Idikha ọnọng ọnangi oyok asilva, obiro ode ekpo ẹdọdọk bi, oye, bẹ akhebha pyẹ k'ọhọhm kw'oyok afhu, bẹ abọk oriribha nwuma, oriribha nwuma ọkhaambi bi ótzuk pyẹ k'igbe ifa.
Yina, idikha bẹ ani oriribha nwuma abọk, ọkhaam-ọhọhm ọkhaambi obe k'itzitzikha s'Ibinọkpaabyi, ifha ọgbaak s'okk'ekpo py'oyok ọfha.

K'aponga biphyir p'akhuri oribh f'ẹbhaam, ọmaana f'ẹnyanyaang, ọmaana f'orukhimaan, ttara f'ibara, obiro ode f'ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ọnọng obeni bi, ‘Faam vọ’, anọng mba afa p'akkaan ọttọhk mva, akhaambi abe k'itzitzikha akpaar-aponga. Ọnọng kw'aponga apyibhi, ọkhaambi otzuk k'igbe ifa ọnang oyok.
“Idikha ọnọng otziri oyok ẹnyanyaang, ode ẹbhaam, ode orukhimaan, obiro ode otzirattọhk kpenamkpen, fẹ ope, ode bi, bẹ amum fẹ ọttọhk, obiro ode bi, fẹ odim-odimi o, da bẹ ani otzum akhe,
bẹ anọng afa atzọkha ọnwọhngi k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, oyok ọttọhk fẹ ọbọhk kọttọhmi. Ọkhaam-ọttọhk ọkhaambi okhera mando, otzukha ma kode.
Yina, idikha bẹ an-abira afhu otzirattọhk mva ofhu, oyok kw'oyok otziri ọttọhk ọkhaambi otzuk fẹ, ọnang ọkhaam.

Idikha ode bi etzen ch'ẹtzam dọ ẹfhu otzirattọhk mva, ẹjaakhi fẹ k'abir-ibiri, oyok kw'oyok otziri ọttọhk, ọ́tzọkha abiri-biri p'etzen nda p'arikhi mach'ẹkhọhkha, bẹ kẹ kábọkha bi, ótzuk otzirattọhk f'ọkk'ọpa.
“Idikha ọnọng ọyaami otzirattọhk f'oyok, bẹ amum fẹ ọttọhk, ode bi fẹ opope, k'ogbe kw'ọkhaam on-ode, ọnọng kw'ọyaami fẹ, ọkhaambi otzuk ọnang ọkhaam.
Yina, ọkhaam owobh mẹ ttara otzirattọhk mva, ọnọng kw'ọyaami fẹ kótzuk. Idikha ọyaami otzirattọhk mva k'agbukha, agbukha p'otzim ọyaam fẹ, atzera otzirattọhk mva f'odimi.
Asana p'akhuri erukkha ch'anọngẹya
“Idikha ojinọng ọbọhr ominanwa kw'oni ojinọng otzim oronga, oyim-ẹ abẹ k'ẹfa, ọkhaambi osi imina sẹ, ominanwa nwa ón-ode kwanọng kwẹ.
Idikha otte kw'ominanwa nwa obhumi biphyir-phyir bi, ọnang-ẹ nnwa kwẹ k'ọbada, ojinọng nwa ọkhaambi da osi imina otzor k'ominanwa kw'oni ojinọng otzim oronga.
“Bọng kwanọng kw'osi mbọng ọbọhk kàtte oruk akpen.
“Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'oyim etzen abẹ, ọbaan bi, bẹ afhẹ-ẹ.
“Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọfọhni ẹja ọnang ọkhak, okhiri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oji, ọbaan bi, bẹ adim-ẹ mebubuni.
“Bọng okhekhennọng ọgbaan kàsi, bọng kẹ ihem kabira kanang, okhuri bi, wa bọbọng akk'akhekhennọng ada k'Ijip.
“Bọng opopa kwanọng, ọmaana opfu-nwa chen kàsi.
Idikha bọng asi bẹ chen, bẹ abhom ayer-m, k'odik-ọkka kaam ḿmaanga ẹmọng chabẹ ọbhaanga.
Mbiri ńgọhkha ittemdọkhiji saam, mbiri ḿfhu bọng ttara ọkkangkkaang. Panọng pabọng án-ade apopa, va pa bọng abira áde apfu-va.
“Idikha bọng abhori ọnọng kpenamkpen kwaam, kw'owobh k'owora ka bọng kw'ottem agbukha, bọng iru kàkhe mach'ọnọng kw'om-obhor anọng agbukha om-osi.
Idikha atzọk owura-baba kw'oyokh-ẹbaanga kwọ mach'ebhikha, rik chẹ yina ẹchọhkha etto,
okhuri bi, chẹ-chẹ dọ ch'om-otzima obubha for e. Mada oyima, mbọng f'obubha, ani chẹ arikh o? Mada obhom oyer-m, kaam ḿmaang-ẹ ọbhaanga, okhuri da kaam ngaam inọngkwo.
“Bọng Ibinọkpaabyi kàlukhi. Bọng ọbaabhi kw'anọng pabọng, ẹmma kabira anang.
“Bọng ẹnanga ch'ọhọhm kw'ọchattọhk fabọng, obiro ode kw'atzuk pabọng kàbọkha atzima. “Bọng akhaambi anang-m achedenva pabọng p'ijinọng.
Eden nduma dani dọ cha bọng asi ttara abhaam, ọmaana arukhimaan pabọng. Tte bẹ awobha ttara abọkka k'iwu izenamfa, yina, ottong iwu izenanttaan, bọng dọkha bẹ anang-m.
“Bọng bọ áde anọng paam p'awur-owur. Mẹ wọ, bọng etzen cha nden s'ẹtzam mfhu, njaakhi k'abirbiri kàchi, bọng dọkha abhari anang mpfa.
